shared_elements: bearded male figure in strict profile
elaborately curled hair and beard rendered as rows of stacked curls
figure holding an object in hand
low-relief carving with flat, outlined forms
horizontal dividing band across the field
justification: Both surfaces depict bearded male figures in strict profile with the same conventional treatment of stacked-curl hair and beard, long patterned robes, and objects carried in the hand, all in flat low relief, which is a fairly specific shared convention of figure rendering. The main difference in content is that A is a single monumental winged genie occupying the whole field with a raised hand and bucket-and-cone attributes, while B shows repeated files of wingless attendants and animals stacked in multiple registers separated by ornamented bands.
